name: Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution
description:
Kelby Contreras, a Florida Luxury Real Estate Specialist with Realty ONE Group Evolution, offers strategic, data-driven real estate advisory to high-net-worth individuals, investors, and developers globally. With over 17 years of experience and A.I. Certified Agent™ status, Kelby provides hyper-accurate pricing strategies and predictive market analytics in the luxury markets of South Florida, including Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and Palm Beach.

Kelby Contreras is a Florida luxury real estate specialist who provides one-on-one representation for buyers, sellers, investors, relocating professionals, and international clients throughout South Florida. He combines the personal accountability of an independent advisor with the resources of Realty ONE Group Evolution, helping clients navigate luxury homes, waterfront residences, condominiums, pre-construction opportunities, investment properties, and confidential off-market transactions. His stated focus is strategic advice, responsive communication, skilled negotiation, and end-to-end support from the first consultation through closing.

Business description
Kelby Contreras | Florida Luxury Real Estate Specialist is a client-focused South Florida real estate advisory practice built around personal representation, market knowledge, and high-touch service. Rather than passing clients through a large team, Kelby serves as the direct point of contact for buyers and sellers who want an experienced agent accountable for the details of their transaction.

With more than 17 years of Florida real estate experience, Kelby represents clients across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties. His work centers on luxury homes, waterfront estates, oceanfront and luxury condominiums, new-construction and pre-construction developments, investment properties, second homes, and relocation purchases. He works with local clients, out-of-state buyers, executives, investors, foreign nationals, and sellers seeking a more strategic or discreet way to market a property.

For buyers, Kelby helps clarify priorities, identify appropriate neighborhoods and properties, evaluate pricing and market conditions, access available and private opportunities, structure competitive offers, coordinate inspections and due diligence, and manage the path to closing. For sellers, he provides property positioning, comparative market analysis, pricing strategy, luxury marketing, pre-screened buyer outreach, offer evaluation, negotiation, and transaction oversight.

Why clients hire Realty ONE Group Evolution:

The strongest differentiator is not that he is a large brokerage or an impersonal “team.” It is that clients work with a named professional who stays involved, communicates directly, and handles the moving pieces of a real estate transaction personally.

His client feedback repeatedly emphasizes:

Prompt responses to calls, texts, and emails

Knowledge of the buying and selling process

Clear explanations and patient answers to client questions

Strong communication from the beginning of the transaction to closing

Professionalism, reliability, and follow-through

Help navigating issues that sellers or buyers did not initially recognize

Coordination with inspectors, lenders, insurers, title professionals, and other transaction participants

Access to useful local professional connections

Support for out-of-state buyers and investment-property clients

Careful seller-side buyer screening and transaction follow-up

These are the themes clients describe across his publicly visible review and testimonial profiles.

Kelby’s website profile states that he has received 220+ five-star reviews, while third-party real estate and consumer platforms include testimonials describing him as professional, responsive, knowledgeable, organized, honest, and effective at helping clients manage the sale or purchase process. The site’s 220+ figure is a self-reported claim and should be verified against the underlying review platforms before using it in paid ads or formal marketing material.

A seller on Zillow said Kelby helped make the selling process easy, provided professional and knowledgeable service, responded promptly, and helped the client feel comfortable throughout the transaction.

Another client described him as responsive, reliable, honest, and willing to go beyond expectations to keep a transaction moving toward closing.

A Yelp review characterizes him as smart, responsive, organized, communicative, and a pleasure to work with.

His testimonial content also includes feedback from an out-of-state first-time buyer who said Kelby helped secure a purchase in Miami and quickly find a renter afterward; other clients describe clear explanations, timely phone responses, help throughout the purchase process, and strong support for sellers facing unexpected transaction issues.

Kelby has earned positive client feedback for responsiveness, professionalism, communication, market knowledge, negotiation support, and hands-on guidance for buyers and sellers. Prospective clients are encouraged to review his public profiles and testimonials when evaluating representation.

Personal Luxury Real Estate Representation for South Florida Buyers and Sellers

Kelby Contreras is a Florida luxury real estate specialist providing direct, strategic representation for buyers, sellers, investors, relocation clients, and international purchasers throughout Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties. With more than 17 years of market experience, Kelby helps clients buy and sell luxury homes, waterfront properties, oceanfront and high-rise condominiums, pre-construction residences, and investment real estate.

Clients work directly with Kelby for market analysis, property search, off-market opportunities, listing strategy, luxury marketing, buyer screening, offer negotiation, due diligence, and closing coordination. His approach is personal, responsive, and built around clear communication—so clients have an experienced advocate from their first conversation through the completion of their transaction.
